svg.title: Allocate a $150,000 Startup Capital Plan
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate a $150,000 Startup Capital Plan; subtitle: Four cash buckets inside the canonical $50,000–$250,000 range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD allocations total $150,000. This illustration uses a fully funded $75,000 BMC-85 trust rather than a BMC-84 bond. Verify eligible trustee, assets, and current requirements. Trust principal remains restricted and cannot also fund carrier payments.; caption: $75,000 + $45,000 + $20,000 + $10,000 = $150,000. A bond-based plan uses quoted premiums and any required collateral instead of assuming $75,000 cash funding. Neither arrangement removes the need to fund shipper-to-carrier timing gaps.; stages: label: Restricted broker trust security; value: $75,000 allocated; 50% of startup capital; numeric value: 75000.0; detail: Fund the illustrated BMC-85 security arrangement separately from operating cash. Track provider charges and any replenishment obligations without treating restricted principal as available working capital.; label: Carrier payment working capital; value: $45,000 allocated; 30% of startup capital; numeric value: 45000.0; detail: At a 20-day gap and 85% carrier-cost ratio, this supports roughly $966,176 annualized billings before buffers. Base throughput needs about $139,726 for that gap, so shorten terms or secure additional funding.; label: Launch operating runway; value: $20,000 allocated; about 13.3% of capital; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Fund lean pre-revenue operations and initial staffing. At $6,000 monthly burn this lasts about 3.3 months, shorter than the six-month first-deal planning boundary; phase hiring or raise the runway allocation.; label: Setup systems and administration; value: $10,000 allocated; about 6.7% of capital; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Budget registration work, process-agent services, contract preparation, TMS configuration, verification onboarding, and accounting setup. Separate one-time charges from recurring monthly operating expense.

rect.title: label: Restricted broker trust security; numeric value: 75000.0; value: $75,000 allocated; 50% of startup capital; detail: Fund the illustrated BMC-85 security arrangement separately from operating cash. Track provider charges and any replenishment obligations without treating restricted principal as available working capital.
